comment: Source read at commit f6cf8d6, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The four time parameters are configured as 0.5 times 0.5 to the power of the value in seconds, -6 to 8 (WindowGenerators.cpp:75), so the knob runs from 32 seconds at the bottom to about 1.95ms at the top and a rising control voltage shortens the stage, which is what makes the time inputs track a volt an octave when the module is cycling. The SHAPE knob feeds each envelope back into its own time parameters, so it changes the timing as well as the curve. The whole plugin is monophonic.
